t: Teen Mom UK: Next Generation: New Highs
d: Matt and Angel welcome a new member to the family! Jack makes a big promise to Chloe and E-H. Whitney and Elizabeth seal their bond. Isha and Jamie's relationship hits new highs and lows.

t: Teen Mom UK: Next Generation: Let Down
d: Angels left holding the baby while her boyfriend is down the pub. Whitney is 37 weeks pregnant! Chloe feels broken, Isha feels lonely, and Ellie is just angry!

t: Teen Mom UK: Next Generation: Under Pressure
d: Whitney is worried about falling behind. Angel and Matt are falling apart. Isha's facing up to her anxiety. Chloe's facing her attachment issues and Ellie is trying to fix her relationship.

t: Teen Mom UK: A New Chapter For Some
d: Teen Moms are back! Sassi's dreams of her future without Darren, and Mia's dreaming of an easier life with Marliya and Maggie. Amber's got her life on track, but Ste could derail things.

t: Teen Mom UK: Old Problems And New
d: Amber's problems with Ste are getting worse and Mia's worried about Marliya after she falls ill. Chloe's making sure Marley's ready to become a brother, and Sassi is chasing her dreams.

t: Teen Mom UK: Looking Forward or Back?
d: Chloe's in a celebratory mood as she finally has the baby shower. Sassi rolls up her sleeves, Amber's dealing with an old foe, and Mia tries to bury the hatchet with Maggie.

t: Teen Mom UK: The Big Days
d: Amber and Ste have a final showdown. Meanwhile, Mia has a final showdown of her own with Maggie. Sassi's launching her brand new business. The big day has finally come for Chloe!

t: Teen Mom UK: New Beginnings
d: Chloe's coming to terms with life as a mum of 2. Sassi is out in the world of dating. Mia is navigating motherhood to a teenager. Amber has a new man.

t: Teen Mom UK: Tension Builds
d: Amber gets upset speaking to her mum about Ste's behaviour. Mia and Manley try to discuss Marliya's attitude which ends in another argument.

t: Teen Mom UK: A Welcome Break
d: Amber and Elliot take the boys on their first trip away all together. Chloe has a stressful week when both the kids are unwell.

t: Teen Mom UK: Family First
d: Mia and Manley sit down with Marliya to discuss her attitude towards them. Chloe and Jordan have a date day without the kids.

t: Teen Mom 2: Season 3 Finale Special: Check Up with Dr. Drew Part 1
st: Season 3 Finale Special: Check Up with Dr. Drew Part 1
d: Dr Drew hosts the Teen Moms in front of a live audience. Jenelle sits down with Jace's dad for the first time in years and Chelsea continues to hold on to Adam despite her father's frustrations.

t: Teen Mom 2: Season 3 Finale Special: Check Up with Dr. Drew Part 2
st: Season 3 Finale Special: Check Up with Dr. Drew Part 2
d: Dr Drew hosts the Teen Moms in front of a live studio audience. Leah reveals some tragic news about her pregnancy and Kailyn struggles to accept Jo's new girlfriend.

t: Teen Mom 2: Under Pressure
d: Leah faces re-emerging feelings for Corey. Jenelle and Gary spend time with Jace. Kailyn and Jo get into a physical fight. Chelsea is worried she might be pregnant again. (S4, ep1)

t: Teen Mom 2: Love Hurts
d: Kailyn and Jo go to court. Chelsea has her first day of beauty school. Leah expresses strong feelings for Corey and Jenelle finds out that Gary had sex with her best friend. (S4, ep2)

t: Teen Mom 2: The Future is Now
d: Leah is torn between Corey and Jeremy. Adam texts Chelsea to see Aubree, but it doesn't go as planned. Jenelle finishes probation and Kailyn takes Isaac to Jo's. (S4, ep3)

t: Teen Mom 2: Faded Love
d: Kieffer and Jenelle are dating again. Kailyn tries to take Jo to court to change their custody agreement. Chelsea tells her mum about the pregnancy scare. (S4, ep4)

t: Teen Mom 2: Fall to Pieces
d: Gary and Jenelle are back together and she tries to be more responsible. Kailyn has a violent outburst toward Javi. Chelsea finds out about Adam's new girlfriend and Leah plans her wedding. (S4, ep6)

t: Teen Mom 2: For Better or For Worse
d: Leah and Jeremy have a courthouse wedding. Adam tries to make Chelsea jealous. Gary has a big surprise for Jenelle. Kailyn and Javi discuss joining the military and getting married. (S4, ep7)

t: Teen Mom 2: Don't be Cruel
d: Gary and Jenelle get into an altercation which lands them both in jail. Chelsea talks to her lawyer about Adam's strange legal letter. Kailyn and Javi consider getting married in Las Vegas. (S4, ep8)
